Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent GAME SPRITE SHEET of a whole character, not separated pieces.
Create 24 complete animation sprites of the same lean human Valdren Warplate Bearer. Elegant fitted pale gray satin ancient armour with restrained antique brass incisions. Completely smooth blank helmet faceplate with no eye slits, mouth, grille or openings. No cloth or skin. Right hand holds a slender straight sword.
Exact regular 4 column by 6 row grid. One full character in each equal square cell. All 24 figures same scale and elevated orthographic isometric camera, facing southeast. Transparent margins around every entire figure and weapon. Muted severe dark medieval painted game art, upper-left lighting. Body standing height 60% cell height, feet at 84% cell height. No floor, shadows, labels, text, gridlines or detached body parts.
Row1: four subtle breathing idle poses.
Rows2-3: eight consecutive walk-cycle poses with opposing legs, alternating heel strikes, planted/passing/lift positions and natural torso motion.
Row4: attack ready, windup, fully coiled windup, extended forward slashing CONTACT.
Row5: attack followthrough, return to ready, hurt recoil, recovering balance.
Row6: death knees buckling, falling sideways, collapsed, fully prone horizontal corpse with sword beside it. Entire corpse remains within its cell.
Each pose is a complete independently drawn sprite with armour and equipment included. Do not cut out, detach, or assemble limbs. True transparent alpha background.

EXACT regular FOUR COLUMNS by SIX ROWS grid, all cells equal square size. Each cell contains one complete character, no parts. NO face or chest front in any living frame.
Muted severe dark medieval painted/pre-rendered game sprite aesthetic, crisp silhouette at 88 screen pixels. Real transparent alpha, no ground, drop shadows, background gradient, text, labels, gridlines or effects.
